_comment: Hg T2 calibrated set (phase 5d, 2026-11-24). Since binT2p5f these are the built-in values of hg_t2 = 1 (hg_t2_preset 1, include/HgTracer.h t2_preset_); this file lists them as an explicit model_settings overlay. T1 / Hg-off paths (hg_t2 = 0) unchanged. See docs_src/WORK_NOTES_hg_t2.md section 9.
_uncertainty: phase 5d: ev_z fixed at 0.3 (physically shallower; not constrained by the targets), humic Kd offset 0; with ev_z 0.3 the local model has no point with all 12 bands met: one of TVC Ro, TVC export, HPC Ro, HPC Rm exceeds by about 1 %; this set keeps 11 in band and HPC Rm about 1.70 (band <= 1.69). f_deep < 1 raises organic Hg:C (retained Hg mixes back) and does not help
